versions.changelog: Enumerate JLCFA standard opening library kinds for enclosure attributes.
Use a hosted usage preview image so registry pages render the BBClaw example reliably.
Add BBClaw usage preview image to the skill introduction.
Add MIT license metadata and document ClawHub/SkillHub installation paths without pinning a private SkillHub registry.

Initial release for JLCFA aluminum alloy enclosure modeling skill:

- Converts user enclosure requirements into machine-readable modeling attributes, with default inference and explicit assumptions.
- Checks all features against JLCFA process and design constraints using a structured workflow.
- Summarizes results as a compact JSON attribute list with a "待确认" (to be confirmed) list for missing or critical details.
- Guides users to consult JLCFA public standards for critical or production decisions.
